name: High Priestess Laurena
summary: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, High Priestess Laurena trains human priests in devotion and arcane wards.

sections.title: A High Priestess of the Cathedral
sections.body: High Priestess Laurena holds a senior post in the Church of the Holy Light. She serves in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light, the heart of the faith, where Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church.

sections.title: Tending the Faithful
sections.body: Behind the central altar in the cathedral sanctuary, High Priestess Laurena mentors aspiring priests. Acolytes who show dedication and piety are sent to her for deeper study. She teaches sacred boons such as Desperate Prayer and defensive spells that turn enemy arcane magic against its wielders. When her students have learned all she can teach, she sends them to other master priests across the Alliance.

faq.q: Where can I find High Priestess Laurena?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena stands behind the main altar inside the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City.

faq.q: What does High Priestess Laurena teach?
faq.answer: High Priestess Laurena trains human priests in foundational prayers, including Desperate Prayer, and wards such as Arcane Feedback against hostile spellcasters.

faq.q: Where did Laurena come from before Stormwind?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded of High Priestess Laurena's life before she took up her post at Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Does she serve under Archbishop Benedictus?
faq.answer: Yes. Archbishop Benedictus leads the Church of the Holy Light and presides over the Cathedral of Light, where High Priestess Laurena holds a senior post.

faq.q: Why does she direct me to other priest trainers?
faq.answer: Once High Priestess Laurena has taught the foundational prayers of the Holy Light, she sends students to master priests of other disciplines, such as dwarven masters in Ironforge or night elf priestesses in Darnassus, to broaden their spiritual learning.

faq.q: Did Laurena lose her family to the undead?
faq.answer: Nothing is recorded of High Priestess Laurena's family.

angles.text: As a priest, you can learn from High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind. She guides human acolytes, teaches Desperate Prayer, and shows them how to disrupt enemy spellcasters.
As a human of Stormwind, you can look to High Priestess Laurena as a spiritual guide at the Cathedral of Light through troubled times.
As an Alliance champion, you can find High Priestess Laurena strengthening the faith of the Alliance from the Cathedral of Light, teaching defenses against dark magic and undead horrors.
